title: XBian 2026.09.25
content: XBian is a small, fast and lightweight media centre Linux distribution for the Raspberry Pi range of single-board computers. It is based on a minimal Debian and it boots into a customised Kodi media centre. Besides the standard Kodi configuration module, Xbian provides a custom application for configuring services, package installations, updates, system backups, and user interface preferences. The distribution uses the Btrfs filesystem.
